basic_info.description: Entertain with confidence! This stylish home boasts downtown views, abundant natural light and bespoke upgrades. A host's dream, this home features a chef's kitchen and a backyard oasis directly accessible from the living space. The designer kitchen has light maple cabinetry, high-end stainless steel appliances (including a Blue Star Professional range), tiled backsplash, wine fridge, and butler's pantry and plenty of additional storage. The backyard is perfect for entertaining and conveniently located off the kitchen with built-in seating, outdoor kitchen with gas grill and wood-fired pizza oven, succulent gardens and a fire pit. The luxurious primary suite boasts views, privacy and a spa-worthy en-suite bathroom. The flexible light-filled guest bedroom can second as additional entertaining space or an impressive home office. A spacious second bathroom completes this home.     Enjoy the best in Bernal, just moments to Precita Park, Bernal Heights Park and all the best restaurants, stores and amenities of Cortland, 24th St and Valencia. Commuting is a breeze with nearby Cesar Chavez, Freeway Access, 24th St BART and Shuttle Stops. 139 Peralta is the home that will have all your acquaintances begging you for their next dinner-party invitation.
